items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Pinky was the MC. And of course you had Jeff and somebody else on the side when we were taking intermission. Yeah I remember.

ctx.x: Yeah I think Pinky had something to do with it.
Pinky was the MC. And of course you had Jeff and somebody else on the side when we were taking intermission. Yeah I remember. But it was a nice job.

You know I had a guy all the way from Australia with me that night. He was an impressive man. Nick Politis. He's a New Orleans style clarinet player from Australia. And his parents are from Greek. He's got a combination.
